summary: Artivion, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of Endospan Ltd., an Israeli aortic-stability-device company. The base purchase price was $175.0 million, paid entirely in cash, with a net payment of approximately $131.3 million after offsetting intercompany loans. Contingent consideration of up to $200.0 million is payable based on future milestones. The transaction was executed via a Securities Purchase Option Agreement dated September 11, 2019, as amended. Escrow accounts of $16.5 million (indemnity) and $1.0 million (adjustment) were established. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Artivion financed the deal from internal sources. The acquisition closed immediately upon filing. Watch for integration of the Nexus product line and potential milestone achievements triggering contingent payments.
